programme.desc: 'S8/E18 - Proper Pirate Proficiency Test'. Captain Captain is wearing her Proper Pirate Proficiency badge and Seaweed realises he doesn't have one! He will have to pass the Proper Pirate Proficiency Test.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy
programme.desc: 'S1/E22 - Puppet Show'. Tallulah puts on a puppet show in the park.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: 'S3/E142 - Relax'. Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Teletubbies Let's Go!
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Magic Cloud Race / Bubbles'. The Teletubbies make friends with a cloud - the cloud splits into four and they race along a rainbow race track, but who is the winner?

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Watering Can'. Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing as they play Peekaboo.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Up and Down'. Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing as they go exploring.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Noisy'. The Twirlywoos discover playing with a radio can have noisy consequences, and the stop-go car comes to visit.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Go to the Moon'. Maisy wants to do one last thing before bedtime: visit the moon with her friends!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: 'S1/E17 - The Tale of the Unguarded Garden'. Follow Peter Rabbit's adventures in this animated series based on the works of Beatrix Potter. Play games, watch clips and sing along.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Dentist'. Charley can't wait to show Dentist Maisy his wobbly tooth!

programme.title: Teletubbies Let's Go!
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Thank You / Superheroes'. The Teletubbies enjoy saying 'thank you' when giving and receiving Thanksgiving gifts, but Noo Noo hoovers up the gifts and blows them out into bubbles!

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Ahoy Captain Pak Choi'. Supertato and Broccoli go on a pirate adventure with Captain Pak Choi, but they don't realise she intends on plundering Evil Pea's freezer and stealing all her shiny things.

programme.title: Topsy And Tim
programme.desc: 'S1/E26 - Growing Sunflowers'. Mummy gives Topsy and Tim some sunflower seeds to grow, and Tim fears the worse when he loses one of them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: 'S5/E16 - The Rollercoaster Badge'. The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Nikhil and Jay and the Boo Contest'. It's Halloween! Nikhil and Jay both want to win the family Boo Contest, but Jim is impossible to spook. Or is he? They just need to find the one thing that scares him.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Connecting'. The creatures tie together the shoelaces of everyone waiting at a bus stop, meaning they all fall over when they stand up. Plus, there is a visit from a very important lady.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: 'S2/E42 - Supertato's Holiday'. Supertato has a holiday but can't relax because Evil Pea is sure to do something evil, like break into Tato Tower - which she does! But without Supertato there, it's not so fun.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Nikhil and Jay and the Deepavali Fireworks'. Nikhil, Jay and their family celebrate Deepavali, also known as Diwali, with kolam, laddus and bunting. But will they be able to watch the fireworks without scaring Max the cat?

programme.title: Mister Maker Around the World
programme.desc: 'S1/E12'. The adventurer makes googly eye glasses in Australia.

programme.title: Swashbuckle
programme.desc: 'S7/E8 - The Pirate Inspector'. A mysterious Pirate Inspector is coming to visit Captain Captain and the pirates. If they fail the inspection, they will get a huge fine. But they soon suspect the Inspector is someone they know!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: 'S1/E14 - Takeaway'. Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: 'S1/E15 - Covering'. The gang decides to cover things after seeing a tablecloth. Meanwhile, everyone gets covered in spots back on the boat.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Dentist'. Charley can't wait to show Dentist Maisy his wobbly tooth!

programme.title: Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins
programme.desc: Henry Golding and Andrew Koji drive this action-packed G.I. Joe spin-off. A tenacious loner is welcomed into an ancient Japanese clan, but his honour and loyalty are tested.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: A wedding gets turned on its head in this outrageously funny comedy. A rivalry between a maid of honour and a bridesmaid for the bride's affection leads to all sorts of chaos.

programme.title: Wedding Crashers
programme.desc: Owen Wilson and Vince Vaughn run this crazy comedy. A pair of friends and womanisers crash weddings to meet women. Things get complicated when one of them falls for a bridesmaid.

programme.title: The Day We Didn't Meet
programme.desc: A great South African film. Alex and Sam reconnect after a chance encounter. They imagine a fantasy life together and abandon all their responsibilities. However, reality sets in.

programme.title: Girl You Know It's True
programme.desc: This is a fascinating music biopic about the music duo Milli Vanilli, who rose to fame in the late '80s and early '90s only to come crashing down after their secret is exposed.

programme.title: Spud 2: The Madness Continues
programme.desc: John Cleese is back as the razor-sharp English teacher in the follow-up to the 2010 South African hit comedy that introduced moviegoers to the coming-of-age journey of Spud.

programme.title: Kipchoge: The Last Milestone
programme.desc: Follow a man's struggle against himself and against time. Kenyan runner Eliud Kipchoge dreams of completing a marathon distance of less than two hours, which is considered unattainable for a human being.

programme.title: Welcome Home, Roscoe Jenkins
programme.desc: Martin Lawrence stars in this comedy from the director of The Best Man. A successful talk show host leaves Los Angeles to reunite with his family in the Deep South.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: Get ready for some good, wholesome fun in this animated joyride. A rookie race car driver gets the opportunity to rally along the famous Silk Road trade route.

programme.title: Paws Of Fury: The Legend Of Hank
programme.desc: A starry voice cast drives this animated film. A down-on-his-luck dog finds himself in a town full of cats who need a hero to help save their village from a ruthless villain.

programme.title: Hop
programme.desc: Russell Brand gives the Easter Bunny a funky new edge in this adorable film. The Easter Bunny's teenage son leaves for Hollywood, where he hopes to become a rocker.

programme.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
programme.desc: Leslie Nielsen takes centre stage in this cult classic comedy. The detective comes out of retirement to help the police infiltrate a terrorist cell planning to bomb the Oscars.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: An action thriller piloted by Gerard Butler. A pilot saves his passengers from a storm by landing on a war-torn island, putting all of them in the path of dangerous rebels.

programme.title: Kick-Ass 2
programme.desc: It's bigger and fiercer in this action-filled sequel. This time, Kick-Ass teams up with other courageous wannabe heroes to stop the Red Mist from exacting his revenge.

programme.title: Immaculate
programme.desc: Unspeakable nightmares awaken in this horror. An American nun discovers her new home, a remote convent in the Italian countryside, harbours a sinister secret.

programme.title: The Fabulous Four
programme.desc: Hollywood heavyweights drive this charming dramedy. Three lifelong friends travel to Florida to be bridesmaids at the surprise wedding of their college girlfriend, Marilyn.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Jenna Ortega and Martin Freeman are entangled in a complex situation in this thriller about a teacher-student relationship that unravels through a special writing project.

programme.title: Greatest Days
programme.desc: A cinematic adaptation of the musical by Take That. Five best friends have the night of their lives. Twenty-five years later, they reunite for one more epic show by their beloved band.

programme.title: Admission
programme.desc: Cute romantic comedy with funny woman Tina Fey (30 Rock). A Princeton admissions officer has a tough choice to make when she meets an applicant who could be the son she gave up for adoption.

programme.title: Spud 3: Learning To Fly
programme.desc: The third instalment of the South African tale follows a now sixteen-year-old Spud Milton (Troye Sivan) who must navigate the difficulties of being a senior at boarding school.

programme.title: One Life
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins leads this true story of bravery. A London broker helps save hundreds of predominantly Jewish children from the Nazis just before the start of WWII.

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: A nail-biting survival thriller. After climbing an abandoned 2000-foot radio tower, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves trapped at the top with no way down.

programme.title: Clifford The Big Red Dog
programme.desc: An amazing canine family adventure. A young girl's love for a tiny puppy named Clifford makes the dog grow to an enormous size.

programme.title: How To Save The Immortal
programme.desc: An epic animated adventure about Russia's fairytale villain. Forced to kidnap a girl, hardened bachelor Koschey embarks on an adventure that makes him a hero he never expected.

programme.title: The Boss Baby: Family Business
programme.desc: Now adults, estranged brothers Tim and Ted must work together again on a Baby Corp mission to defeat a new villain. Features the voices of Alec Baldwin, Eva Longoria and James Marsden.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman and Tommy Lee Jones star in this enjoyable action-comedy. An ex FBI Agent and ex-mob lawyer are forced to put aside their differences to fend off a potential mob hit.

programme.title: Ride Along 2
programme.desc: Ice Cube and Kevin Hart return for another crime comedy filled with drugs, wedding bells and ridiculous antics. All hell breaks loose when the two travel to Miami for a drug bust.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final...
programme.desc: 'Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning'. The spy escapades of Ethan Hunt and the IMF come to an end. They must stop a rogue AI called 'The Entity' before it destroys the world.

programme.title: Black Site
programme.desc: A deadly cat-and-mouse game propels this action thriller. A group of top-secret military black site officers must fight to survive when a murderous detainee escapes.
